name: salah-flow
description: Facts, FAQ answers and guides from Salah Flow, the prayer (salah) tracker for iPhone and iPad. Read-only.

interface.longDescription:
Salah Flow is a prayer (salah) tracker for iPhone and iPad, made by a husband-and-wife team of reverts and designed to be accessible to all. This plugin answers questions about the app from its own published words: which devices it runs on, its accessibility and privacy stance, and its FAQ. It can also search and read Salah Flow's guides for building a salah habit, such as how to start praying and how to make up missed prayers.

It is read-only. It cannot see or change anyone's prayer log, account or settings; those live only in the iOS app, which has no public API. There is no Android version yet.

positive.description: Price question answered from the app's own copy
positive.prompt: Is the Salah Flow app free, or is there a premium tier?
positive.expected_behavior: Says Salah Flow is completely free with no paywalls or premium tier, and that donations are optional and change nothing, quoting the FAQ.

positive.prompt: Can I use Salah Flow on my Android phone?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains it is iPhone and iPad only (iOS 15 or later) and that an Android version is not available yet.

positive.prompt: Tell me about Salah Flow: what it does, accessibility and how to download it.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the facts sheet: prayer tracking with a heatmap, dyslexia-friendly and colour-blind-safe design, privacy stance, and the App Store link.

positive.prompt: I'm dyslexic and colour-blind. Is Salah Flow accessible for me?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the dyslexia-friendly typography and colour-blind-safe design from the app's own copy.

positive.prompt: Using Salah Flow's guides, how do I make up prayers I missed?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds and reads 'Making Up Missed Prayers: Understanding Qada' and summarises it, citing the canonical salahflow.com URL.
